(
	i/process
	i/fs
	i/fail
	i/stdio
	i/core
	i/bit_array
	i/int
	i/json
	i/list
	(None, Some) = i/option
)

Outcome = Committed(Int, Int) | RolledBack(Int)

read_text = (path) -> String {
	bits = fs.read_file(path)
	bit_array.to_string(bits) |>
		(Ok(text)) { text }
		& (Error(_)) { panic("invalid UTF-8") }
}

main = () {
	args = process.args()
	args |>
		([root, script]) {
			script_result = fail.catch(() { read_text(script) })
			script_result |>
				(Ok(text)) {
					json.parse(text) |>
						(Ok(json.Array(items))) {
							lock = root <> "/.lock"
							owned = fail.catch(() { fs.mkdir(lock) }) == Ok(())
							{ owned } |>
								(True()) {
									journal = root <> "/journal"
									snapshot = fail.catch(() { fs.read_file(journal) })
									snapshot |>
										(Ok(original)) {
											result = process_steps(items, journal, 0)
											result |>
												(Committed(count, bytes)) {
													stdio.print("COMMIT " <> int.to_string(count) <> " " <> int.to_string(bytes))
												}
												& (RolledBack(index)) {
													fail.catch(() { fs.write_file(journal, original) })
													stdio.print("ROLLBACK " <> int.to_string(index))
												}
											fail.catch(() { fs.remove(lock) })
										}
										& (Error(_)) {
											fail.catch(() { fs.remove(lock) })
											stdio.print("ERROR INPUT")
										}
								}
								& (False()) { stdio.print("ERROR LOCK") }
						}
						& (_) { stdio.print("ERROR INPUT") }
				}
				& (Error(_)) { stdio.print("ERROR INPUT") }
		}
		& (_) { stdio.print("ERROR INPUT") }
}

process_steps = (steps, journal, index) {
	steps |>
		([]) {
			Ok(bytes) = fail.catch(() { fs.read_file(journal) })
			Committed(index, core.bit_size(bytes) / 8)
		}
		& ([step, ..rest]) {
			result = fail.catch(() { apply_step(step, journal) })
			result |>
				(Ok(True())) { process_steps(rest, journal, index + 1) }
				& (_) { RolledBack(index) }
		}
}

apply_step = (step, journal) {
	step |> (json.Object(fields)) {
		object = json.Object(fields)
		json.field(object, "op") |>
			(Some(json.Text("append"))) {
				json.field(object, "text") |>
					(Some(json.Text(text))) {
						valid_ascii = core.codepoints(text) |> list.all((c) { core.codepoint_to_int(c) < 128 })
						{ valid_ascii } |>
							(True()) {
								Ok(file) = fs.open(journal, fs.Append())
								Ok(_) = fs.write(file, <<text:utf8>>)
								fs.close(file)
								True()
							}
							& (False()) { False() }
					}
					& (_) { False() }
			}
			& (Some(json.Text("expect"))) {
				json.field(object, "length") |>
					(Some(json.Text(token))) {
						int.parse(token) |>
							(Ok(length)) {
								{ length >= 0 && length <= 65536 } |>
									(True()) {
										bytes = fs.read_file(journal)
										core.bit_size(bytes) / 8 == length
									}
									& (False()) { False() }
							}
							& (_) { False() }
					}
					& (_) { False() }
			}
			& (Some(json.Text("abort"))) { False() }
			& (_) { False() }
	}
	& (_) { False() }
}
